MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Andrea Bocelli Si and All That Echoes fit the expressive, polished classical crossover vocals I enjoy in Amor & Pasion, Lead With Your Heart, and Stages.",
    "Partners feels like a natural choice because vocal duets offer the performance-focused appeal I enjoyed in A Musical Affair and Stages."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Elvis: Ultimate Gospel and American Folk Anthology do not meet my current desire for relaxing orchestral music or classical crossover vocals, even if they share familiar voices or traditional songs.",
    "Someday at Christmas and Let It Snow miss my current mood: having listened to Christmas albums before does not mean I want seasonal music now.",
    "In The Lonely Hour feels less suited to my mood, while Duets gives me too little information about the performers to feel confident choosing it."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My past Christmas listening seems to carry too much weight beyond the occasions when I want holiday music.",
    "An interest in melodic singing seems to have been stretched into an interest in almost any vocal collection, although the style and accompaniment matter to me."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My most recent choice, The Most Relaxing Classical Music in the Universe, suggests that calm, soothing music deserves more attention right now.",
    "The connection between expressive crossover singers, orchestral accompaniment, and theatrical performances matters more to me than a shared label such as duets or classic vocals.",
    "I choose selectively, so knowing the performer and recognizing a close connection to music I already enjoy makes a difference."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my interest in expressive vocals but stretch it too broadly and give too little weight to my current preference for relaxing classical and crossover music."
}
